artifact.description: Retrieve the current savings balance for a specified member (input: member_id). Returns savings_balance as currency.

inputs.name: member_id
inputs.description: Member ID entered to retrieve the member record and balances.

selection_context.use_when: Use this capability when you need the current savings account balance for a specific member and can provide that member's ID (member_id). The call returns savings_balance as a currency value.
selection_context.workflow_summary: Search for and open the member record by member ID, then extract the account row whose Type is "Savings" and return its "Current Balance" as the savings_balance.
example_goals: Get the savings balance for member 12345
Retrieve the current savings balance for member 12345
What is the savings balance for member 12345?
Show the savings balance for member 12345
Lookup the current savings balance for member ID 12345
Get the current savings balance for member 67890

business_outcome_rules.reason: The requested member was not found.
business_outcome_rules.visible_text: No member record was found for ID {{member_id}}.

business_outcome_rules.reason: The requested member has no savings account.
